description: Schedule used for application of label rules

schedule_time.description: The time at which the label rules should be run

frequency.description: The frequency at which the schedule is to be executed

day_of_week.description: Applies only in case of weekly schedule and indicates the days on which the schedule will be run.

day_of_month.description: Applies only in case of monthly schedule and indicates the day on which the schedule will be run.
